meta.policy: Only values stated in the cited official/provider source appear here. Null means the source does not publish the value; it is flagged, never inferred. Computed ladder values are deterministic arithmetic from these inputs, labeled as computed, not quotes.

reference_rate.note: Reference conversion for comparing published CNY fees only. Not an executable rate. IRS itself states it has no official exchange rate.

parameters.name: Annual individual FX facilitation quota (settlement; domestic-individual purchase)
parameters.applies: PRC domestic individuals; foreign individuals only with Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card (S05). Not a cap on documented foreign-individual salary conversion (S03).

parameters.name: Foreign individual documented current-account RMB income conversion cap
parameters.locator: Guidelines (2020) Art. 59 as cited by SAFE
parameters.applies: No numeric cap stated; limited to documented lawful income amount incl. tax vouchers. Flag F02.

parameters.name: ID-only daily outward remittance from FX savings account (domestic individual)
parameters.applies: Above this, authenticity documents required. Foreign individuals: ID-based outward remittance from FX savings account (Art. 15), no numeric cap stated.

parameters.name: Overseas ATM cash withdrawal annual cap, domestic bank cards, per person (all cards combined)
parameters.applies: Excess suspends overseas withdrawals current + following year.

parameters.name: Overseas ATM cash withdrawal daily cap per card
parameters.applies: Both foreign-currency and RMB cards.

parameters.name: Foreign cash carry-out, no permit
parameters.applies: Same-day/15-day repeat travelers face lower limits (Art. 6).

parameters.name: Foreign cash carry-out, bank-issued carrying permit band
parameters.applies: USD 5,000-10,000 with bank permit; multiple permits totaling >10,000 not released; >10,000 in principle not allowed (SAFE special-case permit).

parameters.name: RMB cash carry in/out per person per trip
parameters.locator: 2004 adjustment Q&A (Announcement [2004] No. 18); corroborated by S12
parameters.applies: Excess declared and returned; penalties under customs rules.

parameters.name: ID-only unused-RMB reconversion per day (onshore)
parameters.locator: Guidelines (2020) Art. 60 as cited by SAFE
parameters.applies: Only for RMB previously converted from FX and unused; larger reconversions need original exchange memo (24-month validity). Airside before departure: 1,000/day. NOT a general conversion allowance.

parameters.name: Original exchange memo reconversion validity
parameters.applies: Reconversion limited to previously exchanged unused RMB.

parameters.name: HSBC China TT issuance fee, Premier/Advance
parameters.applies: Provider-published tariff effective 2026-10-31; Premier preferential tariff conditional (Note 3).

parameters.name: HSBC China TT cable charge, Premier/Advance
parameters.applies: Per transaction.

parameters.name: HSBC China TT issuance + cable, Private Banking individual
parameters.applies: Private Banking segment eligibility applies.

parameters.name: HSBC China Global Transfer to own overseas HSBC account
parameters.applies: Advance actual charge USD 20 (indicative CNY 145). Requires own-name HSBC account in destination country.

parameters.name: HSBC China Pay Exact (USD full-value delivery) surcharge
parameters.applies: Covers overseas bank charge; shortfall billed to remitter. Premier Elite exempt.

parameters.name: HSBC China foreign banknote withdrawal over counter
parameters.applies: Free all segments; USD/HKD >=5,000 equivalent needs >=3 working days notice; notes buy/sell board rates apply to cross-currency.

parameters.name: Wise from-CNY single transfer maximum (China bank app pay-in)
parameters.locator: How much can I send - China bank app
parameters.applies: Alipay pay-in: 50,000/transfer. Overall limit = documented after-China-tax salary; does not expire.

parameters.name: Wise from-CNY overall sending limit
parameters.applies: Depends on your income and tax records; not publicly fixed. Flag F02.

parameters.name: Wise from-CNY transfer fee
parameters.applies: Not statically published. Flag F03.

parameters.name: Western Union from-China fee and per-transfer limit
parameters.applies: Not statically published; bank-agent risk controls apply. Flag F03.

parameters.name: Bank FX spread (CNY->USD board rate margin)
parameters.locator: Item 2.2.2.1 remark 3 references notes buy/sell board rates; no margin published
parameters.applies: No official static publication of the spread for any provider. Flag F03. Usually the largest real conversion cost (analysis).

parameters.name: Correspondent / receiving-bank charges on SWIFT wires
parameters.locator: Important Note 7 (tariff excludes other institutions' charges)
parameters.applies: Not published by HSBC; depends on route and receiving bank. Flag F03.

parameters.name: PRC IIT comprehensive income rates
parameters.applies: Residents; tax on income when earned, not on conversion. Non-resident wages: RMB 5,000/month deduction (Art. 6(2)).

parameters.name: PRC IIT flat rate - interest, dividends, property lease/transfer, incidental
parameters.applies: Property transfer: on gain (proceeds minus original value and reasonable expenses, Art. 6(5)).

parameters.name: US FBAR filing threshold
parameters.unit: USD aggregate, any time in calendar year
parameters.applies: All foreign financial accounts combined; taxable income irrelevant.

parameters.name: US Form 8938 thresholds (unmarried, living outside US)
US FinCEN 105 cross-border cash reporting threshold
parameters.unit: USD (more than), per person/family/group at one time
parameters.applies: Reporting only; no duty on the currency stated. Failure risks forfeiture + penalties.

parameters.name: US personal FX gain recognition threshold (26 USC 988(e)(2))
parameters.applies: Personal (non-business/non-investment) currency disposition: no gain recognized unless gain >200. 2024 edition; confirm current law (F11).

parameters.name: US FEIE maximum, tax year 2026
parameters.applies: Earned income only; eligibility tests S21; does not exclude passive income or eliminate FBAR.

parameters.name: FBAR civil penalty maxima (assessed on/after 2025-01-17)
parameters.applies: Willful statutory alternative: 50% of account balance (S18). Adjusted annually; reasonable-cause exception exists in statute (not quoted here).

parameters.name: Form 8938 failure penalty
parameters.applies: After IRS notice; criminal penalties may also apply.

parameters.name: PRC FX evasion / fraudulent purchase fine bands (Arts. 39-40)
parameters.applies: Plus repatriation order; criminal liability if crime. Applies to splitting, fake documents, underground swaps (with Art. 45).

parameters.name: PRC private/indirect FX trading fine bands (Art. 45)
parameters.applies: Warning + confiscation of illegal gains; criminal liability if crime. Underground banks / matched swaps.

parameters.name: PRC unlawful cash carrying fine cap (Art. 42)
parameters.applies: Warning; customs penalties may apply instead per law.

parameters.name: US-China treaty source tax caps (dividends/interest/royalties, beneficial owner)
parameters.applies: Saving clause (Protocol para 2): US may still tax its citizens; Art. 22 credit relief per US law.

parameters.name: Emigrant / inheritor asset transfer - SAFE approval, lump sum permitted
parameters.applies: No fixed numeric cap; approval limits the amount. Eligibility: emigrants from Mainland China / foreign-citizen inheritors (S09). Most US-born citizens do not qualify as emigrants (analysis, F05).

parameters.name: Streamlined Foreign Offshore Procedures penalty relief
parameters.applies: Non-willful certification + non-residency requirement; tax + interest still due.
